name: Kenneth Fink
bio: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Kenneth Fink (sometimes credited as Ken Fink) is an American television director and television producer of several television series. Prior to directing, Fink was a television documentary-segment producer. He has directed many episodes of several series including: Dawson's Creek, Oz, Nash Bridges, CSI: Crime Scene Investigation, Millennium, Fringe, Revenge and Nikita.
